title: On Hitting the boy across the face
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：hit　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hit 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the farmer ① hit the boy across the face at once, and every child in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three autumns on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the farmer ② hits the boy across the face in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ hit the boy across the face at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ hit the boy across the face before — a line in the almanac for September 1987 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Hitting the boy across the face at once, the farmer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ hit the hidden rock at the bend in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Hit the hidden rock at the bend at once and never mention it again.

By 2000 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the almanac, and a new child from the next field ⑧ hits the hidden rock at the bend at once every autumn without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the fence, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ hit the boy across the face again when nobody else would.

⑩ To hit the boy across the face, my mother said in 2005, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody hits the boy across the face in the rain again and somebody must hit the boy across the face at once all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 打（一般过去式 hit the boy across the face：1993 年农人头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 打（一般现在 hits the boy across the face：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 打（不定式 to hit the boy across the face：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 打（过去完成时 had hit the boy across the face：1987 年九月的农事历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 打（动名词 hitting the boy across the face 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 撞上（hit the hidden rock at the bend：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去撞上河湾处那块暗礁）

H. v. 打（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 hits the hidden rock at the bend，而母亲又一次 hit the boy across the face）

answers.why: hit 意为“打”，1993 年农人二话不说地打打在那孩子脸上，那是田垄里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 hit。
hit 意为“打”，自那以后农人淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 hits。
hit 意为“打”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯打打在那孩子脸上”，此处为不定式 to hit the boy across the face。
hit 意为“打”，农事历里 九月 那行字说明早在 2000 年之前就有人打过，故用过去完成时 had hit。
hit 意为“打”，农人说“打打在那孩子脸上这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 hitting the boy across the face 作主语。
hit 意为“撞上”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去撞上河湾处那块暗礁”，should ever 之后用原形 hit the hidden rock at the bend。
hit 意为“撞上”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻撞上河湾处那块暗礁（hit the hidden rock at the bend at once），以后再也不要提起。
hit 意为“打”，新来的孩子每个秋天都照例撞上河湾处那块暗礁，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 hits。
hit 意为“打”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地打打在那孩子脸上，用一般过去式 hit 叙述。
hit 意为“打”，结尾那句是母亲 2005 年的话：要打打在那孩子脸上，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和田垄记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 hit 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the farmer hit the boy across the face at once, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the farmer hits the boy across the face in the rain whenever the field asks.
Hitting the boy across the face at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever hit the hidden rock at the bend in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next field hits the hidden rock at the bend at once every autumn, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother hit the boy across the face again, and the field remembered that half.
